## T9.2: store.py touch outside Files list (read-only aggregation helpers)

**Location:** src/akasha/kernel/store.py ("T9.2 read-only metrics aggregation helpers" section, appended after `read_base_snapshot`)
**Details:** T9.2's Files list (src/akasha/metrics.py, src/akasha/api/routes/health.py (or metrics route), tests/unit/test_metrics.py) omits store.py, but rule 0.4 (all persistent-state reads/writes go through store.py) forces this touch -- same recurring precedent as T4.2/T4.4/T4.5/T4.6/T5.1/T5.4/T5.5/T5.7. Added 7 new READ-ONLY functions (facet_coverage_counts, count_reviews_created_since, count_reviews_resolved_since, list_review_created_at_since, count_violations_total, count_nodes_created_since, earliest_node_created_at); none opens a write transaction. Also touched src/akasha/api/app.py (one import + one include_router call to wire the new metrics route) -- not logged as its own question since T4.5/T5.7 set the precedent that a new route file's app.py registration is necessary wiring, not a separate ambiguity.

## T9.2: violation_rate / auto_repairs{class} / sync_cycle_ms{p50,p95} have no live producer yet

**Location:** src/akasha/metrics.py (module docstring SPEC-QUESTION; _CycleRecorder, record_sync_cycle_ms, record_auto_repair)
**Details:** Spec §7 defines violation_rate (violations / sync cycles), auto_repairs{class}, and sync_cycle_ms{p50,p95}, but no existing DB table records per-cycle events -- the §4.4 schema is frozen, and review_queue only records violations needing human review, never a quiet sync cycle or a certain-repair application (which by §4.7 definition never reaches the queue). Accurately observing these requires instrumenting sync/reconcile.py's Reconciler.on_change, which is outside T9.2's Files list and concurrently owned by other build-plan work in this run (T9.1/T9.3 touch reconcile.py/watcher.py/daemon.py). Narrowest-reading resolution: metrics.py exposes record_sync_cycle_ms(duration_ms)/record_auto_repair(code) as an in-process recorder; the three metrics compute from whatever's been recorded so far (0.0/{} until a future task wires the call sites into reconcile.py's certain-repair/cycle-completion points). Satisfies the literal DoD ("every §7 metric appears in /v1/metrics") today, but flagging so a future task (or T9.5's soak-test author) adds the reconcile.py call sites rather than assuming these three are already live.

## T9.2: inflow_variance_30d -- population vs. sample variance unspecified

**Location:** src/akasha/metrics.py (_population_variance)
**Details:** Spec §7 names inflow_variance_30d but doesn't specify population variance (÷N) vs. sample variance (÷(N-1)). Narrowest reading implemented: population variance, treating the 30-day window (zero-filled per calendar day) as a complete, bounded population rather than a sample. Non-blocking -- flagging in case a dogfood-gate threshold (PRD §11) was calibrated against the other convention.
